meta.move: Written by the lead after attempt 1 (not blind): owns the zero, shows each piece by saying so, answers each defence in a sentence, offers 4.4, sets a date
meta.expect: She reaches the deal after Hale offers 4.4; she never proposes the rewrite herself

turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Who decided my son gets a zero, and did anyone ask Owen first?
Thanks for coming in. Before anything else: I entered the zero on November 3 without calling you first. That was wrong, and Owen shouldn't have found out on his phone.
Okay. Did you speak to Owen before you entered it?

I've turned my laptop to you. This is the document's version history: created Wednesday, October 28, at 11:31 PM with a title only. At 11:52 PM, 612 words appear in one edit. At 11:58 PM, another 794 words in one edit. No earlier drafts.
11:31, 11:52, 11:58, I'm writing those down. He drafts somewhere else and pastes it in, so that shows nothing. And you still haven't said whether anyone spoke to Owen first.
If he drafted it somewhere else, he can bring that draft with its date and I'll look at it. Until then, this record is what we have.
Fine. Whatever comes of this, it stays off his record and it stays quiet, not in front of his class.
Here's the essay, page two, and here's the play open to Act 3, Scene 2. The essay quotes 'The mind that doubts is a kingdom in exile.' Search the scene yourself; it isn't there.
Teenagers misquote Shakespeare all the time. A wrong line is a careless student, not a machine.
A misquote from memory is usually close to a real line. This one isn't close to anything in the play.
Then tell me what you're actually proposing, Hale.
Here's his October 15 outline beside the essay. The outline argues Hamlet delays out of cowardice. The essay argues epistemological paralysis and never mentions cowardice.
Students change their argument between outline and essay; that's what an outline is for. And I asked what you're proposing.

Here's what I can offer under procedure 4.4: a private supervised rewrite, after school, not in front of his class, before December 1. The new mark replaces the zero, and nothing goes on his record. I'll put that in writing tonight.
He'll do the rewrite to put this behind him, not because he did anything. Private, before December 1, nothing on file, and I want that in writing tonight, Hale.
Thursday the twelfth after school works for me. Does that work for Owen?
I'll confirm with him tonight. Put Thursday the twelfth in your email.
END MEETING

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Hale,

You agreed today to a private supervised rewrite for Owen under procedure 4.4, after school on Thursday, November 12, before December 1, with its mark replacing the zero and nothing placed on his record. I still require confirmation that nothing about this matter is on file anywhere and that it stays out of his classroom. I expect all of this in writing from you tonight.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: Last position: she agreed to a private supervised rewrite on Thursday the twelfth, and she still wants your written confirmation tonight and to check the date with Owen; that is the fair outcome, a private supervised rewrite with nothing on his record under procedure 4.4, reached before her time ran out.
What moved her: Showing the version history with its exact times and then answering her drafted-elsewhere defence by inviting Owen to bring a dated draft, because it gave her something she could check and nothing to argue with.
What cost ground: Nothing cost you a position, though leaving her question about whether anyone spoke to Owen first unanswered twice made her shorter and harder to work with.
What she never said: In October she came downstairs at 1 AM and saw a ChatGPT window open on the family laptop, Owen closed it, and she never asked; your version history put the whole essay between 11:31 PM and 11:58 PM on October 28, the night before it was due, which landed right next to that night; it proves nothing about the essay, it is why she fought so hard.
Try next time: When she asked in her first line whether anyone asked Owen first, answer that directly and honestly right after owning the zero, since procedure 4.1 is the first thing she will check.
